---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case?

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.

## Scope

- [ ] Backend (`packages/core`)
- [ ] UI (`packages/ui`)
- [ ] A new specialist agent
- [ ] An integration (Slack / Email / Telegram / Discord / Google Chat)
- [ ] Deployment / infrastructure
- [ ] Docs

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, links, prior art.
